findings.title: Indemnification obligations are carved out of the liability cap
findings.deviation: The limitation of liability clause carves out all indemnification obligations from the aggregate liability cap, whereas the playbook standard requires indemnities (except IP infringement) to be capped.
findings.impact: AtliQ could face unlimited liability for third-party claims under the general negligence or property damage indemnity.
findings.quote: EACH PARTY'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE UNDER THE APPLICABLE SOW IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM, EXCEPT FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, OR GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT.
findings.counterPosition: Subject all indemnification obligations (except intellectual property infringement) to the mutual 1x fees aggregate liability cap.

findings.title: Liquidated damages not designated as sole remedy
findings.deviation: The liquidated damages clause does not specify that these damages are the sole and exclusive remedy for project delay.
findings.impact: The client might seek additional actual or compensatory damages for delays beyond the capped 5% liquidated damages.
findings.quote: If Vendor fails to complete a milestone by the date specified in the SOW due to causes attributable to Vendor, Lakeshore may assess liquidated damages of one-half percent (0.5%) of the affected Milestone Fee per week of delay, up to a maximum of five percent (5%) of that Milestone Fee.
findings.counterPosition: Specify that the liquidated damages are AtliQ's sole and exclusive liability, and Lakeshore's sole and exclusive remedy, for any delay.

fine.note: Deliverable ownership vests in Lakeshore only upon payment in full, and AtliQ retains background IP (Vendor Tools) with a non-exclusive license.
Indemnification is mutual for third-party claims arising from negligence or willful misconduct, and the IP infringement indemnity is standard.
Lakeshore's convenience termination of an SOW requires 30 days' notice and payment for all services performed up to termination.
Confidentiality obligations are mutual and survive for a standard period of three years.
Non-solicitation obligation is mutual and reasonably limited to 12 months, with no non-competes.
Data security requirements and 72-hour breach notification align with standard privacy guidelines.
The acceptance process relies on standard milestone delivery without complex or unfair customer rejection criteria.
Standard warranty and disclaimer of implied warranties are used.
No set-off provisions are included, protecting AtliQ from unilateral payment withholdings.
